title: dupatya hirsuta
intro: Dupatya hirsuta, commonly known as Indian spurge, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating pain, and it is often used to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations. The health benefits of Dupatya hirsuta include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of soothing skin irritations and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
